summary: Extended exception hierarchy for the settings subsystem: StorageAuthError, StorageConfigError, StorageConnectionError, StorageValidationError, StorageSecurityError, StoragePermissionError, StorageEncryptionError, StorageTimeoutError, StorageQuotaError, StorageRetryError, StoragePoolError, StorageOperationError, StorageVersionError, StorageStateError, StorageFeatureError, StorageCompatibilityError, StorageMigrationError. These are settings-layer errors distinct from the main exceptions.py hierarchy.
lifecycle_notes: These exceptions are not re-exported from the package root — only the main exceptions.py hierarchy is public
risks: Two separate exception hierarchies (settings vs main) may confuse users if both surfaces raise
open_questions: Should any of these be merged into or aliased from the main exceptions.py hierarchy?

evidence.detail: All 16 exceptions exported from settings package
